description: Expanded AlphaFold control distributions (n=40+ per class) and placement of S. pombe Sil1
code:
import requests, re, os, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
OUT="/agent/jobs/2b70b38c-2ea5-4319-89cb-da475f3f6965/provenance"

def usearch(q,cap=400,fields="accession,organism_name,ft_signal,ft_transmem,sequence,length"):
    out=[];r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
        params={"query":q,"size":500,"format":"tsv","fields":fields},timeout=180)
    while True:
        L=r.text.rstrip("\n").split("\n");hdr=L[0].split("\t");out+=[l.split("\t") for l in L[1:]]
        nx=r.links.get("next",{}).get("url")
        if not nx or len(out)>=cap: break
        r=requests.get(nx,timeout=180)
    return pd.DataFrame(out[:cap],columns=hdr)
sp=usearch('(reviewed:true) AND (taxonomy_id:2759) AND (ft_signal_exp:*) AND (length:[150 TO 320])')
sa=usearch('(reviewed:true) AND (taxonomy_id:2759) AND (ft_transmem:"Signal-anchor for type II membrane protein") AND (length:[150 TO 320])')
def rows(df,col,key,lab,maxstart=10**9):
    out=[]
    for _,r in df.iterrows():
        m=re.search(key+r" (\d+)\.\.(\d+)",r[col] or "")
        if not m: continue
        a,b=int(m.group(1)),int(m.group(2))
        if a>maxstart or b-a+1<12: continue
        out.append(dict(acc=r["Entry"],a=a,b=b,klass=lab,org=r["Organism"]))
    return out
cand=rows(sp,"Signal peptide","SIGNAL","signal")+rows(sa,"Transmembrane","TRANSMEM","anchor",45)
rng=np.random.default_rng(7)
S=[c for c in cand if c["klass"]=="signal"]; A=[c for c in cand if c["klass"]=="anchor"]
rng.shuffle(S); rng.shuffle(A)
sel=S[22:44]+A[22:44]                      # batch 2, disjoint from batch 1
sess=requests.Session(); res=[]
for c in sel:
    try:
        api=sess.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{c['acc']}",timeout=20).json()
        pdb=sess.get(api[0]["pdbUrl"],timeout=35).text
        pl={}
        for line in pdb.split("\n"):
            if line.startswith("ATOM") and line[12:16].strip()=="CA":
                pl[int(line[22:26])]=float(line[60:66])
        seg=[pl[i] for i in range(c["a"],c["b"]+1) if i in pl]
        core=[pl[i] for i in pl if i>c["b"]+25]
        if len(seg)>=10:
            res.append(dict(**c,seg_pLDDT=float(np.mean(seg)),core_pLDDT=float(np.mean(core)) if core else np.nan,seg_len=len(seg)))
    except Exception: pass
B2=pd.DataFrame(res)
B1=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/afdb_controls_batch1.csv")
ALL=pd.concat([B1,B2],ignore_index=True).drop_duplicates("acc")
ALL.to_csv(f"{OUT}/afdb_controls_all.csv",index=False)
sig=ALL.loc[ALL.klass=="signal","seg_pLDDT"].values; anc=ALL.loc[ALL.klass=="anchor","seg_pLDDT"].values
print(f"n signal={len(sig)}  n anchor={len(anc)}")
print(f"signal pLDDT  mean {sig.mean():.1f} +/- {sig.std(ddof=1):.1f}  median {np.median(sig):.1f}  IQR {np.percentile(sig,25):.1f}-{np.percentile(sig,75):.1f}")
print(f"anchor pLDDT  mean {anc.mean():.1f} +/- {anc.std(ddof=1):.1f}  median {np.median(anc):.1f}  IQR {np.percentile(anc,25):.1f}-{np.percentile(anc,75):.1f}")
U,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(sig,anc,alternative="less")
d=(anc.mean()-sig.mean())/np.sqrt((sig.var(ddof=1)+anc.var(ddof=1))/2)
auc=U/(len(sig)*len(anc)); print(f"Mann-Whitney U p={p:.2e}; Cohen's d={d:.2f}; AUC(anchor>signal)={1-auc:.3f}")

POMBE=61.6
# Gaussian likelihood ratio for the pombe observation
ls=stats.norm(sig.mean(),sig.std(ddof=1)).pdf(POMBE); la=stats.norm(anc.mean(),anc.std(ddof=1)).pdf(POMBE)
print(f"\nS. pombe Sil1 segment pLDDT = {POMBE}")
print(f"  percentile within signal-peptide controls: {100*(sig<POMBE).mean():.0f}th")
print(f"  percentile within anchor controls:         {100*(anc<POMBE).mean():.0f}th")
print(f"  Gaussian likelihood ratio signal:anchor = {ls/la:.1f} : 1")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.6))
ax[0].hist(sig,bins=np.arange(30,101,5),alpha=.6,color="#2e86ab",label=f"cleaved signal peptide (n={len(sig)})")
ax[0].hist(anc,bins=np.arange(30,101,5),alpha=.6,color="#e09f3e",label=f"type II signal anchor (n={len(anc)})")
ax[0].axvline(POMBE,color="#d1495b",lw=2.5)
ax[0].annotate("S. pombe Sil1\n20-42 = 61.6",(POMBE,6.5),color="#d1495b",fontsize=9,ha="right")
ax[0].set_xlabel("mean AlphaFold pLDDT of N-terminal hydrophobic segment")
ax[0].set_ylabel("proteins")
ax[0].set_title("AlphaFold confidence separates cleaved signal peptides\nfrom type II signal anchors")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
bp=ax[1].boxplot([sig,anc],labels=["signal\npeptide","type II\nanchor"],widths=.5,patch_artist=True)
for b,c in zip(bp["boxes"],["#2e86ab","#e09f3e"]): b.set_facecolor(c); b.set_alpha(.6)
ax[1].scatter(np.random.default_rng(3).normal(1,.06,len(sig)),sig,s=10,color="#1b5e7a",zorder=3)
ax[1].scatter(np.random.default_rng(4).normal(2,.06,len(anc)),anc,s=10,color="#a8700f",zorder=3)
ax[1].axhline(POMBE,color="#d1495b",ls="--",lw=2)
ax[1].text(2.42,POMBE+1,"S. pombe Sil1",color="#d1495b",fontsize=9,ha="right")
ax[1].set_ylabel("mean segment pLDDT")
ax[1].set_title(f"Mann-Whitney p = {p:.1e}, Cohen's d = {d:.2f}")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
